states.name: OFF
behaviour: System draws minimum power from the vehicle battery ( <xx mA)
System waits for receiving the wake up signal (Ignition or CAN communication)
System has no communication with the vehicle

states.name: Initialization
behaviour: System recieves the wake up signal (Ignition or CAN communication)
System draws power from the vehicle battery

states.name: Enable
behaviour: System draws power supply from the vehicle battery
System assists in reducing the steering effort
System assists in damping undesirable forces acting on the steering system
System assists by executing vehicle commands
System assists in both reducing the steering effort and also executes vehicle commands at the sametime

states.name: Disable
behaviour: System draws power supply from the vehicle battery

faults.response:
* Most severe type of response
* Immediate removal of assist
* Competent control of the motor cannot be assured

faults.definition: Controlled shutdown fault (Faults in the torque path)
faults.response:
* The torque path is disconnected from the operator and the motor is commutated with the motor velocity command
* Output is ramped out as a function of motor velocity and time

faults.definition: Information only fault (Performance or information only related faults)
faults.response: * System continues to operate and certain features are disabled or operated in a reduced performance mode
* System ramps out assist as a function of time
